text: Men wi'atah si wanaa yoga e reweteeɗi amen ɗin meminirii ma bone feetere, tawde hiɗa haɗude men e rewugol ɗi. Huudu maaki: "Min miɗo seedina Alla -seeditee onon kadi- wonnde min, ko mi daɗndiiɗo e rewugol reweteɗi mon ɗin gaanin Alla. Fewjanee lam onon e reweteeɗi mon ɗi aaƴotoɗon ɗin wonnde ɗi memirii lam feetere, refti wata on nennitanam.
